categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in advanced non-ferrous metal powder materials, including copper-based metal powder materials, high-end microelectronic tin-based solder powder and interconnection materials, 3D printing powder materials, and electronic pastes. These products serve industries such as powder metallurgy, superhard tools, microelectronic packaging, friction materials, catalysts, electrical alloys, carbon products, conductive materials, heat pipe materials, and 3D printing. The business is divided into four main segments: advanced copper-based metal powder materials, high-end microelectronic solder and interconnection materials, 3D printing powder materials, and electronic pastes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes core technologies including spherical metal powder preparation, high-quality electrolytic copper powder green preparation, lead-free environmentally friendly microelectronic solder powder design and preparation, diffusion/composite powder homogenization preparation, ultra-fine metal powder preparation, 3D printing powder preparation, and high-performance powder metallurgy hollow camshaft preparation. Production methods involve electrolytic, atomization, mechanical crushing, chemical, powder metallurgy powder preparation, and post-processing. The company emphasizes continuous automatic closed powder preparation, digital workshops, green manufacturing, and intelligent control technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global leading automotive parts suppliers, renowned powder metallurgy enterprises, friction material producers, carbon brush manufacturers, and leading domestic companies in powder metallurgy, superhard tools, and electrical carbon products. The microelectronic solder powder segment serves world-renowned solder manufacturers. End markets span automotive, high-speed rail, machinery, aerospace, microelectronics packaging/assembly, chemical, national defense, mold manufacturing, and biomedical industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with industrial bases in Beijing, Chongqing, Anhui, and Shandong, and international bases in the UK and Thailand. Its products are sold globally to over 30 countries and regions including Europe, North America, Latin America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia. The company maintains a global sales and after-sales service network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the non-ferrous metal powder supply chain, focusing on the design, research, production, and sales of metal powder materials. It procures raw metals such as copper, tin, silver, and nickel, processes them into advanced powder materials, and supplies these to downstream manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening core technology competitiveness, expanding downstream application fields, and promoting green and intelligent manufacturing transformation. The company focuses on R&D in nano metal powder materials, high-performance powder metallurgy, and 3D printing powders. It emphasizes market-driven innovation, collaborative research with universities and downstream enterprises, and accelerating product iteration and industrialization. The company also invests in digitalization, automation, and green energy projects such as photovoltaic power generation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of metal powder materials and related products. Pricing follows a 'raw material price plus processing fee' model, with production based on sales orders to mitigate raw material price volatility. The company uses direct sales as the main sales channel, supplemented by limited buyout distribution.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and international player in advanced non-ferrous metal powder materials, holding the top domestic market share in copper-based metal powder and microelectronic tin-based solder powder. It has strong brand recognition and technological leadership, with competitive advantages in scale, technology, and global market presence. Major competitors are not explicitly named, but the company is positioned as an industry leader with significant barriers to entry for new competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.23 billion, a 20.44% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 59.38 million, up 7.73%. The company’s total assets reached RMB 1.72 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.21 billion. R&D investment accounted for 3.43% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased sales volume and technological innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced metal powder materials with stable performance and customized solutions tailored to customer needs. It leverages proprietary core technologies to produce spherical powders, environmentally friendly solder materials, and high-performance 3D printing powders. The company’s value proposition includes rapid response to customer process optimization, product innovation, and integration of digital, intelligent, and green manufacturing to enhance product quality and cost efficiency.
